section.title: Put the page to sleep
section.lead: Is your organisation winding up or taking a break? Put the page to sleep: it disappears for everyone, and any administrator can wake it up within {{days}} days.

confirm.title: Put {{name}} to sleep?
confirm.body: Here is what changes as soon as you confirm.
confirm.hidden: The page, its offers, its jobs, its events and its posts disappear for everyone, your team included.
confirm.deadlines: Requests, applications and registrations stay as they are on the page side, but their deadlines keep running: an unanswered request can expire, and its author is told; a job offer can close when it is due.
confirm.live: A live stream of the page in progress stops.
confirm.kept: Memberships, followers and the team are kept.
confirm.silent: Nobody is notified that the page is asleep. If registrants must be told, cancel your events first.
confirm.reversible: Any administrator of the page can wake it up from “My pages” until {{date}}: everything that has not expired in the meantime then comes back.
confirm.after: After that date, only the ANTSIA platform team can act.

myPages.title: Asleep
myPages.lead: These pages are no longer visible. While the period runs, any administrator can wake them up: each one comes back with everything that has not expired in the meantime.
myPages.expired: Period ended on {{date}}: only the ANTSIA platform team can act now.
myPages.adminOnly: Only an administrator of the page can wake it up.

manage.title: This page is asleep
manage.asleepBody: {{name}} is no longer visible, nor are its offers, jobs, events or posts. Any administrator can wake it up until {{date}}.
manage.expiredBody: {{name}} has been asleep for more than {{days}} days: it can no longer be woken up from here, and nothing has been erased. Only the ANTSIA platform team can act.

expired.contactLabel: Write to the platform team about {{name}}

orphan.title: This page no longer has anyone in charge
orphan.claimBody: Nobody administers it today. Do you represent it? Claim it with supporting documents: the network moderation will decide.
orphan.pendingBody: Nobody administers it today. Your claim is being reviewed by the network moderation.
orphan.contactBody: Nobody administers it today. To tell us who represents it, write to the DIASPORALE team.

errors.page_sleep_expired: This page has been asleep for more than {{pageSleepDays}} days: it can no longer be woken up from here. Only the ANTSIA platform team can act.
errors.moderation_desk_page_asleep: This page is asleep: the claim can only be refused.
